event.title: HEVN, inc announced its public launch
event.summary: HEVN, inc announced its public launch in a dated company video.

evidence.title: HEVN (YC P26): Launch video
evidence.excerpt: HEVN is a B2B financial platform that lets global internet companies operate in USD. Join HEVN: hevn.io ● Run your business in USD with corporate cards and global payments with 0% FX fees ● Get named local accounts in EU, US, HK and UAE banks in 1 day ● Send and receive ACH / SEPA / USDC / wires worldwide
